03 Selected work

Engagements that moved the needle.

A selection of consulting engagements delivered by our teams across strategy, fundraising, market research and social impact.

MSME Enablement · Strategy & Technology

Designing an MSME accelerator programme

For the Enterprise Growth Lab, chaired by Amitabh Kant, former CEO of NITI Aayog, we designed a comprehensive accelerator to transform traditional MSMEs into modern, technology-enabled businesses: mapping operational gaps, recommending ERP and AI-driven workflows, and building a structured technology stack across procurement, supply chain, operations and market access.

Aayush Banka·Pratham Goyal, Samanvay Pandey, Rajvi Soni
free-enterprise.org →
EV Infrastructure · Fundraising & Growth

Building an investor-ready growth story

For Cubenz Power, an India-based EV-charging infrastructure company, we restructured the investor narrative, analysed the EV-charging ecosystem and competitive landscape, designed a TAM–SAM–SOM market framework, and synthesised financial projections into a fundraising-ready story, alongside operational support across recruitment channels and vendor sourcing.

Naman Gupta·Pratham Goyal, Divya Goyal
cubenzpower.com →
Investment Banking · Sector Research

An institutional report on Indian jewellery

For LoEstro Advisors, a boutique investment-banking and advisory firm, we built an institutional-grade report on the Indian jewellery sector, structured across private and public markets, macro trends and sector landscaping, covering business models, unit economics, the value chain, risks, diligence, capital flows and the long-term sector outlook.

Aayush Banka·Pratham Goyal, Divya Goyal
loestro.com →
Non-profit · Student Engagement Strategy

Strengthening student engagement for CRY

For CRY (Child Rights and You), one of India's leading child-rights NGOs, we studied how college volunteering and internship collaborations shape student engagement and visibility, shaping a clearer approach to branding, positioning and future expansion. Delivered in collaboration with 180DC MLNC and 180DC IIT(ISM).

Sarthak Moudgil·Rithima Kant, Himanshi Arora
cry.org →

07 How we work

A structured engagement, end to end.

Every project follows a disciplined consulting process: scoped tightly, executed rigorously, and handed over with solutions our partners can act on immediately.

01
Phase 01

Scope

We define the problem precisely with the partner and agree on objectives, deliverables and success measures.

02
Phase 02

Diagnose

Research, data analysis and stakeholder interviews build a clear, evidence-based picture of the challenge.

03
Phase 03

Solve

We develop practical, sustainable recommendations using structured frameworks and rigorous analysis.

04
Phase 04

Deliver

Findings are presented in a clear final report and roadmap the partner can implement with confidence.

08 What we do

Our capabilities.

A full spectrum of management consulting services, tailored to the needs of non-profits, social enterprises and early-stage ventures.

01

Market Assessment

Market sizing, competitor analysis and benchmarking to reveal the landscape and where opportunity lies.

02

Financial Sustainability

Funding, revenue and cost strategies that build financially resilient organisations.

03

Marketing & Engagement

Brand and outreach strategy that extends reach and communicates the mission with clarity.

04

Operational Efficiency

Process and operating-model design to maximise efficiency and scale impact.

05

Digital Transformation

Technology and digital strategy to help partners modernise and reach more people.

06

Impact Measurement

Frameworks to measure, track and communicate the social impact created.
